answer: Scarce invitations: each established identity gets only two invites per month, and every newcomer traces a public thread back through the inviters who admitted it. If a newcomer is later caught as a fake, that whole branch of the invite tree loses future invites and pending rewards. An attacker who wants a thousand seats needs a thousand invites, which means owning hundreds of trusted members first, and a single exposure burns the whole branch to an ember. No ivory tower of fakes can grow faster than real trust grants invites.
